name: ca.mathter/mathter
title: Mathter
description: Printable K-12 math worksheet packs with answer keys. Sign in with your Mathter account.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: Lists the math skills worksheets can be made for, and the grades each one covers. Call this before make_worksheet_pack to get a valid skill key.

tools.name: check_allowance
tools.description: Shows how many worksheet-pack credits the account has used and has left this month, and when they reset. Does not spend a credit.

tools.name: make_worksheet_pack
tools.description: Makes a printable math worksheet pack with an answer key and returns a link to the PDF. Spends one credit. Use a skill key from list_skills and a grade that skill covers.

skill.description: A skill key from list_skills, for example "multiplication".

grade.description: Grade level, 0 (kindergarten) to 12. Must be a grade the skill covers.

worksheetCount.description: How many worksheets in the pack. The account's plan may allow fewer.

diagrams.description: Draw the figures (shapes, graphs, clocks) in the skills that have them. list_skills shows which skills and grades do. Asking for it where there are none is refused and no credit is spent.

includeAnswerKeys.description: Print the answer key. On by default; false leaves it out.

workedSolutions.description: Add step-by-step worked solutions, for the skills that have them. Refused for other skills, with no credit spent.

includeCover.description: Add a cover page. Refused, with no credit spent, if this account's plan does not include cover pages.

includeLesson.description: Add the how-to lesson page. Refused, with no credit spent, if this account's plan does not include lesson pages.

style.description: Typography and layout. Defaults to modern. Refused, with no credit spent, if this account's plan does not include that style.

problemsPerPage.description: Questions per page. Reduced to what fits one page for the skill.

unitSystem.description: Units for measurement questions. Defaults to metric.

graphBlank.description: Coordinate grids are blank by default so students set their own scale; false prints a labelled grid.

focus.description: Drill one number (1 to 12) in addition, subtraction, multiplication or division. Refused for other skills.

focusOrder.description: Order of a focus drill. Only used with focus.

chart.description: Add a multiplication chart, filled in or blank. Multiplication only.

timed.description: Make it a timed one-minute drill. Addition, subtraction, multiplication and division only.

title.description: Optional title printed on the pack.
